description: Creates a BuzzMeBro setup for the person and returns setup_id and a status_token you must keep for every later call (plus setup_url, a fallback link if you cannot relay a texted code). Only call it after check_building said available and the person has asked you to set it up. No text message is sent and nothing is charged by this call. Next: send_phone_code.

agent_name.description: Optional: your name as the person knows you (e.g. "ChatGPT", "Claude"), shown on their link page.

mobile_phone.description: The person’s own mobile number. It becomes the first phone the buzzer rings and how they sign in; we text it a code when they open the link.

postal_code.description: The apartment building’s postal code, e.g. "M4B 1B3". Canadian postal codes only for now.

referral_code.description: Optional BuzzMeBro referral code from a friend.

unit.description: Their apartment or unit number as the lobby panel lists it, e.g. "1502", "B" or "PH3".

name: create_setup
title: Set up BuzzMeBro for the person
